log.text: MEMOBRICK › CALM BUILD GIFT | Calm Build Gift | A calm, predictable project with a clear finish: a 16×16 brick mosaic of a photo they love, built one row at a time. Build it together or alone, in short sessions, at your own pace. | Every brick is the same small 1×1 brick. Only the color changes. The bricks come in labeled bags sorted by color, matching the printed color map, so you can open one bag at a time and follow the map row by row until the picture appears. We put together a free printable plan to make each session simple and clear. | We made this gift with autistic people and their families in mind, and for anyone who likes a calm, step-by-step project. We say "autistic people" because many autistic self-advocates prefer it. | What's in the gift | The 16×16 DIY brick mosaic kit, $69.88. One baseplate, 2,500 bricks in labeled color bags, a printed color map and the building tool. About 2.5 hours of building, easy to split into short sessions. | Their own photo. A pet, someone they love, a favorite place or something they are into. Upload it in our editor and see the mosaic before you order. | The free Calm Build Plan. A 3-page printable to download below. No email needed. | Optional: a black 16×16 frame, $49, sold separately, for hanging the finished piece. | The frame is optional. Add it in the cart if you'd like it. | Download the Calm Build Plan | Three pages: a 6-step plan, a tracker for all 50 rows of the 16×16, and cut-out cards that say NOW, NEXT, STOP HERE, BRE
